bull.probability_evidence: Record FY2026 organic ASV growth of 7.0% (Q4 FY2026 earnings release, 2026-09-30, fact sheet News & sentiment) and all five of FDS's current multiples sitting ~11% below their own 5y minimum (e.g. P/E 18.7x vs 20.9x min; factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation/RA) support the odds of a P/FCF re-rating toward its 5y low of 15.8x, as named in the evaluation's bull basis.

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation table 5y-minimum multiples re-rate the current price (272.78) by different degrees depending on anchor: P/E 20.9x/18.7x=+11.76% -> 304.9; EV/EBITDA 14.1x/12.5x=+12.80% -> 307.8; P/FCF 15.8x/13.7x=+15.33% -> 314.6 (factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation). Spread 304.9-314.6 = 9.76; half-spread 4.88 / target 315 = 1.55%.

base.probability_evidence: FCF margin rose 2.2pp to 28.6% TTM and FCF/NI reached 132.6% while shares outstanding fell 4.62% YoY (factsheet-2026-10-08.md Quality/Other); continuing buybacks without a new catalyst is the most likely path given 95%+ ASV/client retention (SEC 10-K, cited in note.md) and no evidence yet of client losses (Scotia Wealth expansion, fact sheet News).

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation table shows P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF all sitting at the same -11% position versus their own 5y minimum (factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation: Position in 5y range column), i.e. no disagreement between these anchors at current levels; the base target's move above the current price comes entirely from buyback-driven per-share accretion (shares -4.62% YoY, ST), not from choosing between valuation anchors, so the band is 0.

bear.probability_evidence: FY2026 operating margin fell 3.9pp (32.2%->28.3%) and the SEC 10-K names Bloomberg, LSEG, S&P Market Intelligence, MSCI and Morningstar AI-enabled products eroding demand (note.md s2); short interest is 10.86% of float and rose 7.0% month-on-month (factsheet-2026-10-08.md News & sentiment), consistent with informed capital betting on continued structural margin erosion; the macro overlay's small bear tilt (rising real yields capping the re-rating leg) adds to this probability (research/FDS/2026-10-08-macro.md macro_tilt).

target_band.cite: Bear basis assumes FY2026's operating-margin decline (32.2%->28.3%, -12.11% relative; factsheet-2026-10-08.md Quality/IS) repeats at a flat multiple. Margin-sensitive anchors (P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/FCF, all held flat) imply 272.78*0.8789=239.8, matching the 240 target; the margin-insensitive EV/Sales anchor (revenue and multiple both assumed flat, factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation) implies an unchanged 272.78. Spread 272.78-239.8=33.0; half-spread 16.5 / target 240 = 6.88%.
